name: trail
description: Session sidebar of the Jira tickets, PRs, GitHub Actions runs, incidents and docs a session created, changed or mentioned (plus TeamCity builds if you use it), as clickable links, and a status row (model, branch, context, rate limit, resumable session id).

accent.title: Accent color
accent.description: Accent color for the status strip and sidebar

atlassianServer.title: Atlassian MCP server
atlassianServer.description: Name of the Atlassian MCP server as /mcp lists it. Used for Jira titles only when your permission rules allow its searchJiraIssuesUsingJql tool.

githubOrg.title: GitHub org
githubOrg.description: Org whose PRs show as 'repo #N' without the owner. Empty: the session repo's owner.

incidentOrg.title: incident.io org slug
incidentOrg.description: incident.io org slug for INC-<n> links. Empty: detected through the incident.io connector when it is allowed; otherwise incidents are off.

jiraBaseUrl.title: Jira base URL
jiraBaseUrl.description: Site that ticket keys link to, e.g. https://acme.atlassian.net. Empty: detected from the jira CLI config or the Atlassian connector.

jiraProjects.title: Jira project keys
jiraProjects.description: Comma-separated project keys to recognize. Empty: the projects your Jira site shows you (jira CLI or Atlassian connector).

sectionLimits.title: Section limits
sectionLimits.description: Items shown per sidebar section before '+N more' (starred items always show): jira, pr, inc, run (GitHub Actions), build (TeamCity), doc

sounds.title: Sounds
sounds.description: Short chimes with the pop-ups: created, merged or build succeeded, and build failed (macOS; other platforms stay silent)

statusStyle.title: Status line
statusStyle.description: band: colored, clickable row just above the prompt (folder opens Finder, ⧉ copies the resume command, 🔗 toggles the sidebar); bottom: plain, unclickable line under the prompt; off: no status row, sidebar only (keeps your own status line)

teamcityUrl.title: TeamCity URL
teamcityUrl.description: Only if you use TeamCity: the server build ids link to. Empty: the server the teamcity CLI is logged in to; without that CLI, TeamCity stays off.

toastSeconds.title: Pop-up seconds
toastSeconds.description: How long notification pop-ups stay on screen (2-60). The latest one also stays clickable in the status row until your next message.
